class.name: PushNotificationToken
class.brief_description: Requests iOS push notification permission and provides the APNs device token.
class.description: Add this node to your scene tree (or use it as an autoload singleton). It swizzles the Godot AppDelegate to capture the APNs device token and exposes it via signals. Typical usage: 1. Connect to [signal token_received], [signal token_failed], and [signal permission_result]. 2. Call [method request_permission]. 3. On [signal token_received], send the token string to your backend.

method.name: request_permission
method.description: Prompts the user for notification permission. If granted, automatically registers for remote notifications. Results arrive via [signal permission_result] and then [signal token_received] or [signal token_failed].

method.name: register_for_remote_notifications
method.description: Re-registers for remote notifications without showing the permission dialog. Use this on subsequent app launches after the user has already granted permission.

method.name: get_device_token
method.description: Returns the last known APNs device token as a hex string, or an empty string if not yet available.

members.member: The most recently received APNs device token (hex-encoded string).

signal.name: token_received
signal.description: Emitted when the APNs device token is successfully received. [param token] is the hex-encoded token string suitable for sending to your push notification server.

signal.name: token_failed
signal.description: Emitted when registration for remote notifications fails. [param error] contains the localised error description.

signal.name: permission_result
signal.description: Emitted after the user responds to the notification permission prompt. [param granted] is [code]true[/code] if they allowed notifications.
